TIMING, 8x512 prompt, 64 new tokens, median of 3 after 1 warmup
  enable_gqa   (as shipped) :   3.394s  [3.391, 3.415]  ['MATH']
  pre-expanded K/V          :   2.520s  [2.497, 2.522]  ['EFFICIENT_ATTENTION']

  pre-expanding is 1.35x faster on IDENTICAL work

  Both timings above ran the SAME uniform batch; the only difference is the K/V input shape, forced by the monkeypatch. HuggingFace picks the first form whenever attention_mask is None -- i.e. whenever nothing was padded -- so on this device the no-padding case is the 1.35x SLOWER one. A genuinely ragged batch would take the fast path here, but it would also be different work, which is why this script holds the batch fixed and flips the flag instead.
